# Helvety PDF

> PDF toolkit currently available at no cost. Merge, reorder, delete, rotate, and extract PDF pages in the browser. In current architecture, file contents are processed locally for supported operations and are not intended to be uploaded to Helvety servers for file conversion. Engineered and designed in Switzerland.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://helvety.com/pdf): PDF toolkit with merge, reorder, rotate, delete, and extract features

## Helvety Ecosystem
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com): Main Helvety website with company information and legal pages
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Official store for Helvety products and services (availability and pricing may change)
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth): Centralized authentication for all Helvety apps
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Contact management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Task management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields

## Optional
- [GitHub](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Public monorepo for all Helvety applications (source-visible, not open source)
